text.p: SangStat Medical Corp said Friday it could reach profitability in 1998.

"With two drugs under active FDA review for the significant immunosuppressive market, growing support from the transplant community as a result of multiple collaborative research studies and clinical trials, and a strong cash position, we feel increasingly optimistic, subject to timely market approvals, that our focused strategy for 1998 profitability is achievable," said Philippe Pouletty, M.D., Chairman and CEO.
SangStat said Friday it lost $4,532,000 or $0.33 per share for the first quarter of 1997. This compares with a net loss of $3,043,000 or $0.29 per share for the first quarter of 1996.
Total product revenues in the first quarter of 1997 were $690,000 compared to $711,000 in the first quarter of 1996.
